raw_response:
I farm these 20 mu like I did last year. Same as my neighbors. I don't go changing things for no reason.

I keep 5 mu for cotton on the sandy piece near the road — that ground don't hold water well, cotton does alright there. The other 15 mu I plant wheat in autumn, then maize straight after I cut the wheat in June. That's how it's been done here forty years.

**Wheat (15 mu):** Before I plow, I put down 1 bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that's the 15-15-15 one, 50 jin bag. Some years I use the 45% one if the dealer has it cheap. Then in spring when the wheat starts to green up, I give it 1 bag of urea for every 2 mu. My neighbor Old Wang puts more, but I don't see his wheat any better than mine. I water it 3 times — once after planting, once in spring green-up, once when the head is coming out. Well water, I got my own pump. Wheat usually gives me 800-900 jin per mu, that's 400-450 kilo. I spray once for aphids in spring, that's usually enough.

**Maize (15 mu):** After wheat I don't plow, just use the no-till planter — the contractor charges 30 yuan a mu, saves me time. One bag of compound per mu when planting, then top-dress 1 bag urea per mu at the big flare stage when it's about to tassel. Water twice if the rain don't come. Maize gives me 1100-1200 jin, so about 550-600 kilo. Spray once or twice for borers.

**Cotton (5 mu):** Cotton eats money and time but I'm used to it. I plow this ground proper. Half bag compound per mu at planting, then urea maybe 30 jin per mu when it starts to flower. Cotton needs lots of spraying — bollworm, aphids, whitefly — I spray maybe 5-6 times through the summer. Water 3 times. I get about 500 jin seed cotton per mu, that's 250 kilo.

I don't buy fancy seeds. I use what the dealer in town sells — improved wheat seed and the hybrid maize everybody plants here. Cotton seed is hybrid too, Bt cotton, everyone uses that now because of the bollworm.

Two old mouths to feed, what I sell covers the inputs and a little left over. I don't gamble with new ways.
